WITH GroupedData AS (SELECT client_unique_id, ANY_VALUE(payout_id) AS payout_id, amount, transfer_amount, discount_fee, transaction_fee, reserve, net_amount, settlement_amount, settlement_reserve, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Credits' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS refund, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Pre-Dispute Resolution' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS rdr, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Chargeback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS cb, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Chargeback Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS cb_cancelled, o.merchant_id, client_unique_id AS order_id, d.currency AS currency_id, c.short_name AS crypto_id, o.crypto_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Credits' THEN transfer_amount ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS refund_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Pre-Dispute Resolution' THEN transfer_amount ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS rdr_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Chargeback' THEN transfer_amount ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS cb_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'Chargeback Cancelled' THEN transfer_amount ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY client_unique_id ) AS cb_cancelled_amount, merchant_refund_fee, merchant_rdr_fee, merchant_chargeback_fee, merchant_processing_fee, merchant_rolling_reserve, merchant_gateway_fee, 'Merchant' AS fee_type, CASE o.`status` WHEN 0 THEN 'Created' WHEN 1 THEN 'AML Start' WHEN 2 THEN 'AML Pause' WHEN 3 THEN 'AML Decliened' WHEN 4 THEN 'Waiting for Deposit' WHEN 5 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 6 THEN 'Deposit Decliened' WHEN 7 THEN 'Order Cancelled' WHEN 8 THEN 'Fulfilled' WHEN 9 THEN 'Finished' WHEN 10 THEN 'Refunded' WHEN 16 THEN 'Blacklist' WHEN 17 THEN '3DS Pending' ELSE 'Unkown' END AS order_status, o.created_at, o.sso_order_id, fx_rate, merchant_settlement_fee, fx_rate AS eur_usd, d.country AS issuing_country, CASE
WHEN cc.country IS NOT NULL THEN 'EU' ELSE 'NON-EU' END AS region, movement_date FROM movement_data d LEFT JOIN `order` o ON d.client_unique_id = o.id LEFT JOIN crypto_currency c ON o.crypto_id = c.id LEFT JOIN country_category cc ON cc.country = d.country WHERE movement_import_id = #{movementImportId}) SELECT payout_id, client_unique_id AS row_labels, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS sum_of_amount, ROUND(SUM(discount_fee), 2) AS sum_of_discount_fee, ROUND(SUM(transaction_fee), 2) AS sum_of_transaction_fee, ROUND(SUM(reserve), 2) AS sum_of_reserve, ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS sum_of_net_amount, ROUND(SUM(settlement_amount), 2) AS sum_of_settlement_amount, ROUND(SUM(settlement_reserve), 2) AS sum_of_settlement_reserve, refund, rdr, cb, cb_cancelled, merchant_id, order_id, currency_id, ROUND(SUM(transfer_amount), 2) AS order_amount, crypto_id, ROUND(sum(crypto_amount), 2) AS crypto_amount, ROUND(sum(refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount, round(sum(rdr_amount), 2) as rdr_amount, round(sum(cb_amount), 2) as cb_amount, round(sum(cb_cancelled_amount), 2) as cb_cancelled_amount, ROUND(SUM(merchant_refund_fee), 2) AS refund_fee, ROUND(SUM(merchant_rdr_fee), 2) AS rdr_fee, ROUND(SUM(merchant_chargeback_fee), 2) AS chargeback_fee, ROUND(SUM(merchant_processing_fee), 2) AS processing_fee, ROUND(SUM(merchant_rolling_reserve), 2) AS rolling_reserve, ROUND(SUM(merchant_gateway_fee), 2) AS gateway_fee_usd, 'Merchant' AS fee_type, order_status, created_at, sso_order_id, ROUND(fx_rate, 2) AS fx_rate, ROUND(SUM(merchant_settlement_fee), 2) AS settlement, ROUND(fx_rate, 2) AS eur_usd, issuing_country, region, MAX(movement_date) AS latest_movement_date FROM GroupedData GROUP BY client_unique_id;

SELECT d.client_unique_id,d.currency AS currency_id, d.payout_id, d.amount, d.transfer_amount, d.discount_fee, d.transaction_fee, d.reserve, d.net_amount, d.settlement_amount, d.settlement_reserve, d.movement_type, d.merchant_refund_fee, d.merchant_rdr_fee, d.merchant_chargeback_fee, d.merchant_processing_fee, d.merchant_rolling_reserve, d.merchant_gateway_fee, d.merchant_settlement_fee, d.fx_rate, d.country, o.merchant_id, o.status AS order_status_raw, o.created_at, o.sso_order_id, o.crypto_amount, o.fiat_amount, c.short_name AS crypto_id,'Merchant' AS fee_type FROM movement_data d LEFT JOIN `order` o ON d.client_unique_id = o.id LEFT JOIN crypto_currency c ON o.crypto_id = c.id WHERE d.movement_import_id = #{movementImportId} ORDER BY d.client_unique_id
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(movement_date, '%Y-%m') from movement_data WHERE movement_import_id = #{movementImportId} limit 1

SELECT s.id as merchant_id,IFNULL(SUM(merchant_settlement_fee),0) as merchant_settlement_fee FROM movement_data d LEFT JOIN `order` o on d.client_unique_id = o.id LEFT JOIN shop s on o.merchant_id = s.id WHERE d.movement_import_id = #{movementImportId} AND s.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.merchant_settlement_fee), 0) AS total FROM movement_data AS m LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON m.client_unique_id = o.id WHERE o.`status` = 9
AND o.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
